name: Triffis
description: Triffis was a planet that was the homeworld of the Triffian species, including the podracer Ebe E. Endocott. It was located in the Triffis system along a major hyperlane in the Hevvrol sector of the Mid Rim Territories, in grid square O-15 of the Standard Galactic Grid.
